title: Step 4 - Model Selection Process: Evaluating Classification Algorithms

cues.en: Instructor: It beat by very little, you know the accuracy of the kernel SVM.
cues.zh: 它只以非常微小的差距，超越 Kernel SVM 的準確率。

cues.en: The kernel SVM did eight incorrect predictions five plus three.
cues.zh: Kernel SVM 有 8 個錯誤預測，也就是 5 加 3，

cues.en: And the Decision Tree Classification, did four plus three seven incorrect predictions resulting in having an accuracy almost equal to 96%.
cues.zh: 決策樹分類則是 4 加 3，共 7 個錯誤，因此準確率幾乎等於 96%。

cues.en: Wow, that's really, really good.
cues.zh: 哇，真的非常好。

cues.en: You know, this is the first time actually that I'm doing this, you know trying this breast cancer data set, with you, with all these models.
cues.zh: 這其實是我第一次和你一起，用全部這些模型測試這份乳癌資料集。

cues.en: I tried it once with logistic regression in another course but this is the first time that I implement all these models and deploy them to do a model selection process on this data set.
cues.zh: 我在另一門課曾用邏輯斯迴歸測試過一次，但第一次實作並套用全部模型，對這份資料做模型選擇。

cues.en: So, you know that shows you how I'm confident about these code templates.
cues.zh: 這也顯示我對這些程式範本有多大信心，

cues.en: I never tried them before on this data set and I'm making this demo with you for the first time on this data set.
cues.zh: 之前沒在這份資料集上測過，就第一次直接和你一起示範。

cues.en: All right, so therefore the excitement, and now final one.
cues.zh: 所以我才這麼興奮。現在最後一個，

cues.en: I'm very curious to see if we can still beat it with Random Forest Classification.
cues.zh: 很好奇隨機森林分類能不能再超越它。

cues.en: So let's do this, Run, All and final accuracy is...
cues.zh: 來吧，Run all，最後準確率是……

cues.en: Whoa. Oh, alright. Okay.
cues.zh: 哇，噢，好吧，

cues.en: So very disappointing.
cues.zh: 很讓人失望，

cues.en: The Random Forest Classification indeed really messed up with the teamwork.
cues.zh: 隨機森林分類這次團隊合作真的搞砸了。

cues.en: And that's another exception to the rule because you know usually teamwork is better than individual work.
cues.zh: 這又是一個例外，因為通常團隊合作比單打獨鬥好，

cues.en: But no, we had a very powerful Decision Tree Classification model before and it didn't need anybody else to be performant, alright?
cues.zh: 但這次不是，先前的決策樹模型非常強，根本不需要其他幫手就能有好表現。

cues.en: So that's very interesting actually.
cues.zh: 這真的很有趣，

cues.en: This is very surprising results, but that's why it's really really important to try all your models and have these very efficient code templates that allow you to do a quick
cues.zh: 結果非常出人意料，也正因如此，一定要試過所有模型，並準備高效率的程式範本，讓你能快速

cues.en: and efficient model selection process to quickly figure out the best model.
cues.zh: 而有效地進行模型選擇，找出最好的模型。

cues.en: All right?
cues.zh: 好嗎？

cues.en: You have to understand that there is no rule of thumbs.
cues.zh: 必須了解，沒有絕對通用的經驗法則。

cues.en: And for some other data sets with other machinery problems the best model will be another one of these five models.
cues.zh: 在其他資料集與機器學習問題上，最佳模型可能是這幾個模型中的另一個。

cues.en: All right, so it was really important for me to show you this and to give you this.
cues.zh: 所以對我來說，示範並提供這些內容非常重要。

cues.en: Okay, so now there we go, my friends we are at the end of part three classification.
cues.zh: 各位，第三部分「分類」到這裡結束了，

cues.en: Big congratulations to you for, well, completing this part three and making such a good progress on this course.
cues.zh: 恭喜完成第三部分，在課程中有了這麼大的進展。

cues.en: Now, in the next part, we will start clustering, which will be our first unsupervised model.
cues.zh: 下一部分開始分群，會是我們第一個非監督式模型。

cues.en: I remind that the difference between supervised and unsupervised is that with supervised learning, you know what to predict you know, which dependent variable to predict.
cues.zh: 提醒一下，監督式與非監督式的差別，在於監督式學習知道要預測什麼，也就是要預測哪個應變數，

cues.en: And with unsupervised learning, you don't know what to predict and you will actually have to find some patterns in the data to figure out something you could predict as a dependent variable
cues.zh: 非監督式學習則不知道要預測什麼，必須從資料中找規律，才能找出可作為應變數預測的內容，

cues.en: but that you don't have a priori and that you create a posterior.
cues.zh: 這個目標不是事前已有，而是事後建立的。

cues.en: All right? So no worries.
cues.zh: 不用擔心，

cues.en: We will see all this in the next part.
cues.zh: 下一部分會看到完整說明。

cues.en: And until then, I think you deserve a good break now.
cues.zh: 在那之前，我想你值得好好休息，

cues.en: So get some good rest, relax a bit and as soon as you're packed back with some great energy, well join us in the next part to tackle clustering.
cues.zh: 休息放鬆一下，等恢復充沛精力，再加入下一部分，一起處理分群。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習。
